news.title: Solarium Green Energy Limited Announces Chief Financial Officer Changes, Effective January 9, 2026
news.body: Solarium Green Energy Limited On the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, appointed Mr. Rohit Jindal as Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and Key Managerial Personnel (KMP) of the Company, with effect from January 09, 2026. The appointment has been made to further strengthen the Company's financial management and governance framework in line with its growing business operations. His experience and leadership are expected to support the Company's financial functions and long-term growth strategy. The company announced Change in designation of Mr. Himanshu Garg, currently serving as Chief Financial Officer (CFO) & Key Managerial Personnel (KMP), to President - Growth and International Business of the Company along with Business Finance.

news.title: Solarium Green Energy Limited Appoints Himanshu Garg President ­ Growth and International Business, Effective January 9, 2026
news.body: Solarium Green Energy Limited announced that on the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, the designation of Mr. Himanshu Garg, presently serving as Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and Key Managerial Personnel (KMP) of the Company, has been changed to President ­ Growth and International Business, along with Business Finance, with effect from January 09, 2026.
